final_message:
I've written the June 2026 draft trend report for ABC Inc and saved both files in `evals/runs/policy-run-20261013/b_abc_rounding_vanished_lines/skill_output/`:
- `abc-inc-2026-06-trends.md`: the draft report, with my 8 commentary bullets in section 1 and the "DRAFT for reviewer" label kept.
- `abc-inc-2026-06-trends.json`: the full analysis, which is the source for every figure.

The workbook covers Jan 2025 to Jun 2026 (18 months), so June is the latest month and the trailing-twelve-month (TTM) and year-over-year comparisons are both available.

**Data quality:** every check passes (subtotals, gross profit, operating income, net income, and the balance sheet balancing). There were no parsing warnings, and June isn't flagged as a partial month.

**Key points from the commentary:**
- **Revenue:** 195,898 in June, down 6.0% from May (208,351). May was the highest month in the export, so the drop is from a peak. June is down only 0.5% against the prior 6-month average (196,946) and up 2.8% on Jun 2025 (190,556).
- **Margin and costs:** gross margin was 70.2%, up 3.1 points on May and equal to the prior 6-month average, but 4.2 points below Jun 2025. Operating expenses were 468,182, down 2.2%. The biggest move is Finance & Admin, which went from 15,243 to -993, mainly because Bad Debts went from 12,935 to -1,806.
- **Net income and cash:** net income was -330,756, the 6th negative month in a row, and -3,089,780 over the last twelve months. Cash was 713,481, down 215,543 from May and down 1,871,836 from six months earlier.
- **Lines at zero:** these are written as observations, and the reviewer decides whether each has stopped or is just timing.
  - Two revenue streams (Professional Services, Partnership Income) and two expense lines (Federal & State Taxes, Marketing/Advertising: Miscellaneous) are zero in June.
  - SKU Profiling revenue has been zero since May 2026 (last non-zero Apr 2026).
  - Advisory Services has been zero since Feb 2026 (last non-zero Jan 2026).
  - The Professional Fees account has been zero since Apr 2026 (last non-zero Mar 2026).

**"Other" category:** one expense account, General Expenses (149 in June), matched no category rule and is grouped under "Other Opex".

Every figure in the commentary is copied exactly from the report or JSON; none are rounded or calculated by hand. Possible causes, whether items like the Dec 2025 stock-based compensation and bonus are one-offs, and whether tax and interest should be reclassified are all left to the reviewer, as listed in section 10.
